property_summary: For any callee address and calldata selector, the reference C.forward never reverts when the callee itself succeeds or fails (it propagates failure only when the external call itself fails to execute), so calling forward always returns (ok==true) when the low-level call returns success and returns (ok==false) when it fails; the mutant flips this on success (reverting when the callee call succeeds), so there exist calldata/selectors for which reference returns but mutant reverts.
change_summary: Change to revert explicitly when the call succeeds (flip to revert on success using require(false) when _s true).
